Don't worry about it! When you play with fire, you get burned!
I mean, c'mon, your opponent was me! You didn't have a chance!

That is correct!
It is I, Cress, Water-type enthusiast, whom you must face in battle!
What incredible luck for you—you get to battle the best among the three of us.
Just as water flowing from high places to low places is natural, so is my victory.
quotes.lose: Lose? Me? I don't believe this.
quotes.win: This is the appropriate result when I'm your opponent.
quotes.lobbyLose:
How amazing!
Even if there were a lot of reasons, you managed to defeat someone as impressive as me!
quotes.lobbyWin:
How amazing!
Even if there were a lot of reasons, you managed to take on someone as impressive as me!

intro: Well then, Trainer, I'm going to research how you battle!

Welcome!
I'm the director of the Nacrene Museum and former Leader of the Nacrene Gym, Lenora!
Well then, challenger, I'm going to research how you battle with the Pokémon you've so lovingly raised!

quotes.lobbyWin: Ah ha ha! If you lose, make sure to analyze why, and use that knowledge in your next battle!

quotes.announce: The premier insect artist! Burgh, your canvas is here!
intro:
Thanks again for your help.
My Bug-type Pokémon are scurrying with excitement about getting to battle you. Let's get straight to it!

If the battle brings out the beauty in Bug-type Pokémon, it will be a scene that makes my heart flutter, win or lose.
My bug Pokémon are abuzz with anticipation.
Let's get straight to it!

If I win this battle, I feel like I can draw a picture unlike any before it.

Let's get straight to it!
quotes.lose: Is it over? Has my muse abandoned me?
quotes.win: Wow... It's beautiful somehow, isn't it...
quotes.lobbyLose:
Aww... I lost.
Whatever! Losing to you doesn't bug me, because you are a-MAZ-ingly strong!
quotes.lobbyWin: Sometimes I hear people say something was an ugly win, but I think if you're trying your best, any win is beautiful.

quotes.announce: The shining beauty, the sparkling bolt of electricity, Elesa!
intro: My beloved Pokémon are going to make your head spin!

I am me, and Pokémon are Pokémon!
I feel that strongly when I battle with Pokémon moves, and that's why I do it.
Now, my beloved Pokémon are going to make your head spin!

quotes.lobbyLose: My, oh my... You have a sweet fighting style.
quotes.lobbyWin: You're a shining star of a Trainer, but my Pokémon shone brighter!

quotes.announce: The underground boss, Clay! Rising from the depths of the soil!
intro:
Yer tougher than ya were when I gave ya that Gym Badge, right?
Well, how 'bout we have ourselves a look and see what ya can do now.

How much stronger ya get comes from how much you want to win!
Always be loyal to that desire, ya hear?

If ya want ta win, don't make excuses! Got it?
If yer gonna bellyache, just forget 'bout fightin'!
Well, I might be fussin' 'bout nothing when it comes to you.
quotes.lose: Well, I've had enough... And just so you know, I didn't go easy on you.
quotes.win: It's simple, hear! I wanted to win more than ya did!
quotes.lobbyLose:
Fer such a young 'un, ya have an imposin' battle style.
I wonder what kind a journey ya had that made ya so strong.
But, I still don't like losin'!
quotes.lobbyWin:
What's important is how ya react to losin'.
That's why folks who use losin' as fuel to get better are tough.

quotes.announce: The high-flying girl, Skyla! Send 'em flying with your fabulous moves!
intro: Why don't you and I have some fun?

What I like is having fun!
I love doing things like flying in the sky with Pokémon and bringing out their best!
So, how about you and I have some fun?

It's finally time for a showdown!
That means the Pokémon battle that decides who's at the top, right?
I love being on the summit! 'Cause you can see forever and ever from high places!
So, how about you and I have some fun?
quotes.lose: Being your opponent in battle is a new source of strength to me. Thank you!
quotes.win: Win or lose, you always gain something from a battle, right?
quotes.lobbyLose:
You're a pretty amazing Pokémon Trainer, aren't you?
My Pokémon and I are happy, because for the first time in a while, we could fight with our full strength.
quotes.lobbyWin: I'm sure I'd have a great time if I could battle Winona, the Hoenn Gym Leader, up in the air!

quotes.announce: The quiet ice mask, Brycen! Lights, camera, action!
intro: You appear ready to face a battle.

You appear ready to face a battle.
Bring it!

Receiving their support makes you stronger.
I'll show you this power!
quotes.lose: The wonderful combination of you and your Pokémon! What a beautiful friendship!
quotes.win: Extreme conditions really test you and train you!
quotes.lobbyLose: You are strong! No, both you and your Pokémon are strong!
quotes.lobbyWin:
The path of an actor was something I gave up once...
Because of that, I poured all of the things I was able to see and do into competition.

quotes.announce: The Spartan mayor, Drayden! Stalwart and strong!
intro: What I want to find is a young Trainer who can show me a bright future.

Thinking about aging is thinking about the time you have left.
Now, since there are fewer things I can do,
what I want to find is a young Trainer who can show me a bright future.

What I want to find is a young Trainer who can show me a bright future.

quotes.win: Harrumph! I know your ability is greater than that!
quotes.lobbyLose:

I'm grateful we had a chance to meet and battle.
Make a bright future—not just for yourself, but for others as well.
quotes.lobbyWin:
How unsatisfying!
Promise me that we'll see each other here once again!

quotes.announce: Toxic music and toxic words! Show 'em what you've got, Roxie!

Fight with this Pokémon this way... Use this item that way... Are you letting others decide that for you?
Well, whatever, but what's important is figuring out what you want to do!
Get ready! 'Cause I'm going to knock the common sense outta you and drag you into a brand new world!

You don't do anything! What do you know?!
You don't do anything! How're you gonna change?!

Wild!
Your reason's already more toxic than mine!
quotes.win: Hey, c'mon! Get serious! You gotta put more out there!

I was weak and made my Pokémon feel how much losing stinks!
Watch out! Next time we meet, I'm going to give you a toxic shock!
quotes.lobbyWin:
Ya can't win 'em all. It's impossible, seriously!
Trying to look cool every time you mess up or fail is totally exhausting!
So you just have to let it all hang out!

Even if hurt, my Pokémon will fight for me with just one command.

What can I do for these Pokémon? What should I do?

Our important friends, Pokémon...
